works.title: The Apostolic Fathers
works.subtitle: Greek Texts and English Translations, 3rd ed.
works.author: Michael W. Holmes
works.blurb: The standard scholarly diglot of the earliest sub-apostolic writings, including Ignatius's seven authentic letters, to the Ephesians, Magnesians, Trallians, Romans, Philadelphians, Smyrnaeans, and Polycarp, written on the way to martyrdom.
